text:
maria: kicking off a staged rollout for inference-service v2 to eu-west-1 now. plan is blue/green with 10% increments every 5m into preemptible-gpu-pool. pls watch IPAM and kube-proxy logs

deploy-bot: rollout started for inference-service:v2 -> green revision r42. initial traffic 0 -> 10% at 1755550300
kai: noted. last time we hit IP allocation errors when node drains overlapped with kubelet restart. will watch node events and cordon/uncordon timings
jen_sre: +1. also re-check helm hooks for the migration job — saw a race where postStart created an external ENI claim too early
maria: rolling out step 1/6. attaching quick check commands:
```
# watch for ipam failures
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=ipam-controller --tail=200 | grep -i alloc
# check node conditions
kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep gpu
```

kai: hit a warning at 1755550155 — ipam-controller: "insufficient addresses in subnet euw1-preemptible-1". looks like available /28 pools are exhausted for that AZ
release-lead: can we attenuate traffic to 0% for the green revision while we resolve? I prefer a fast revert rather than slow degradation in prod
jen_sre: propose automated fallback: if ipam errors > 5 in 2m then rollback to blue and mark pool as quarantined in gitops config. we can implement a quick helm value toggle and let the release pipeline revert
maria: agree. creating a short-lived gitops patch to set stagedTraffic: 0 for green and add annotation for pool-quarantine
```
# helm values patch (applied via patch job)
stagedTraffic:
  inference-service:
    green: 0
```

deploy-bot: alert rule triggered: ipam_allocation_errors_rate > 5 in 120s. initiating autorevert per override by release-lead
kai: cluster autoscaler also attempted to scale up 2 nodes but they were pending due to subnet IP exhaustion — logs show 2x ASG create failed with ENI attach timeout
jen_sre: action items: (1) add temporary secondary /24 pool to euw1-preemptible-1 (ops ticket), (2) update gitops to quarantine pool and pin blue, (3) add helm pre-hook that waits for ip availability metric before shifting >10%
release-lead: prioritizing ops ticket now. we’ll resume rollout after pool is expanded and we validate 30m of healthy allocation metrics

maria: thanks all. learning: progressive delivery + constrained IPAM needs an explicit safety check in the pipeline. I'll open a follow-up RFC with suggested gating logic and a small Helm hook snippet for wait-for-ip metric
kai: thanks — will keep an eye on node events and post the ASG error traces in the incident thread. :eyes:
